propositions: A new peer-confirmation store module must persist full confirmation records (link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, source) per managed link using a relation-scoped key (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation).

The outbound link dispatch path must invoke a link_confirm callback after set_relationship succeeds, capturing the returned link_id and recording the confirmation without perturbing link counts or failing the dispatch.
An unbound target (when binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must skip recording entirely without raising, and never persist vendor keys in local-id fields.
The peer_confirmations.json file must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames to ensure confirmation-only changes are committed and survive snapshot compaction.
A corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json must load as an empty store without raising, degrading gracefully to 'nothing confirmed' until backfill restores state.
Any exception raised by the link_confirm callback must be logged and swallowed to prevent confirmation write failures from cascading to the outbound link that already landed.
